preserved_source_quirks: Construction does not inspect or register a runtime; registry lookup occurs only at the two spawn calls.
Last detach removes route mapping, attacher and viewer queue before attempting to spawn the reaper.
Every created session gets generation 1; no source path increments generation on reattach/recreate.
The create cap check releases the session lock before opening a PTY; it is not a reservation.
Default shell candidates are constructed before open_with can choose attach or refuse the cap.
Attach ignores supplied dimensions and inherits the current reconciliation.
Reconcile always attempts a control send; changed-size broadcast and last_size update also occur on control-send failure.
Initial create passes raw u16 dimensions; only reconciliation clamps zero minima to one.
Session list order follows HashMap iteration, without sorting.
Bridge replays nonempty scrollback as one Data, forwards empty Data and Exit, and continues after Exit until channel close or send failure.
Bridge skips lagged broadcast messages and awaits each bounded mpsc send.
Close kills directly before best-effort Shutdown and route removal; it does not remove viewer queues.
Host detach removes the requested viewer queue even if there was no route/session; disabled-host detach is a no-op.
Stop closes the route's session, but removes only the requested route's viewer queue.
Thread-spawn failure logs an error and does not become an open error; worker join handles are not retained.
Exit waits 120ms and uses the scrollback guard, without a reader completion join or durable total-order guarantee.
